# Copper Wren Dental Studio
> Copper Wren Dental Studio is a fictional East Austin, TX practice offering family checkups, clear aligners, children's dentistry and emergency visits.

This is a fictional demo clinic. It is not a real practice.

Address: 4107 Shoal Terrace Lane, Suite 3, Austin, TX 78702. Phone: (512) 555-0176. Open Monday, Tuesday and Thursday from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., Wednesday from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m., and on Saturday from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m.

## Services
- [Services](https://www.copperwrendental.example/services): Dental care at Copper Wren Dental Studio in Austin, TX: family checkups and cleanings, tooth-colored fillings, crowns and bridges, clear aligners and more.
- [Family checkups and cleanings](https://www.copperwrendental.example/services/family-checkups): Exams and cleanings for every age in one visit, with X-rays only when your dentist needs them.
- [Clear aligners](https://www.copperwrendental.example/services/clear-aligners): Removable clear trays that move teeth gradually, planned after an exam and a conversation about your goals.
- [Children's dentistry](https://www.copperwrendental.example/services/kids-dentistry): Gentle, unhurried visits for children, starting with a first appointment where the main goal is to feel at home.
- [Same-day emergency care](https://www.copperwrendental.example/services/same-day-emergency): Pain, a broken tooth or a lost crown? We hold time each day for emergency visits and an on-call dentist outside office hours.

- [Clear Aligners or Braces? Questions to Ask Before You Start](https://www.copperwrendental.example/blog/clear-aligners-or-braces): Both straighten teeth, but they suit different people. These are the questions worth talking through with your dentist before you choose.
- [How Often Should Kids See the Dentist?](https://www.copperwrendental.example/blog/how-often-should-kids-see-the-dentist): Most children do well with a checkup about twice a year, but some need more. Here is how we set a schedule for your child.
